fits.fact: Hobbyists have used small tanks sold as 'Opti-White Nano' for planted nano setups. One example was a TGM Optiwhite Nano of about 35 x 22.7 x 25 cm, run with CO2.
Small tanks of this kind have also been used for cherry/sakura shrimp breeding colonies and for 15-litre moss tanks, according to forum posts.

issues.fact: 'Opti-White' describes a low-iron, extra-clear glass, not a specific model. In forums the name covers several makers' tanks and custom builds, most of them from years ago, so no single product can be pinned down.
Some UK hobbyists had opti-white nano tanks custom-built or bought the glass to assemble themselves instead of buying a ready-made kit.

alternatives.why: A current complete nano set that includes substrate, lighting and a filter. It comes in several sizes under 40 L, which suits beginners.
A ready-made nano kit for plants, shrimp and small fish. Its LED has two daylight levels and a blue night mode.

alternatives.why: A cheaper local route: buy a low-iron (siêu trong) tank made in Vietnam and add a separate nano LED. This gives the same clear-glass look.
